m: Season the thighs and sear 5 to 6 minutes a side until golden. Rest, then slice.
Same pan: garlic and sliced sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add the cream, stock powder dissolved in ¼ cup water, and oregano. Simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the parmesan and spinach until wilted. Add the chicken back.
Cook the pasta, keep some pasta water, and toss through the sauce.
l: Pasta water or a splash of milk brings the sauce back when reheating.
g: GF pasta in a separate pot. Check the stock powder.
